item.title: C++ Documentation Generators: Doxygen vs Standardese vs hdoc vs moxygen
item.description: Generating API documentation from C++ source code has been dominated by Doxygen for over two decades. But modern alternatives like Standardese, hdoc, and moxygen offer C++-aware parsing, cleaner output, and better integration with contemporary documentation workflows. This guide compares four C++ documentation generators and helps you choose the right tool for your project.
